preview.body:
Hi,

Attached are our 2025 Forms W-2, the Forms 1099 and our mortgage papers. The organizer, last year's return summary, the tax and gift spreadsheets, the estimated payment log and the HANGS letter are in the shared folder. Please prepare our 2025 Form 1040.

A few things:

- We refinanced in June. The new lender sent a 1098; the old one never did, so we used the payoff statement.
- The Children's Hospital Foundation has not sent the receipt letter for our September gift yet.
- Our IRS online account shows only three of our four estimated payments for 2025. The January one says 2026.
- HANGS withheld Additional Medicare Tax on Celeste's pay; Brennan's district did not.

Thanks,
Celeste Whitford

sources.title: Form 1040 (2025), U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

passages.q: Which 2025 Form 1040 lines does the draft fill?
passages.a: 11a Subtract line 10 from line 9. This is your adjusted gross income ... 13b Additional deductions from Schedule 1-A, line 38 ... 26 2025 estimated tax payments and amount applied from 2024 return

passages.q: What is the 2025 standard deduction for a joint return?
passages.a: For 2025, the standard deduction amount has been increased for all filers. The amounts are: ... $31,500-Married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse.

passages.q: How is the tax figured on taxable income of $100,000 or more for a joint return?
passages.a: Section B-Use if your filing status is Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse ... At least $100,000 but not over $206,700 x 22% (0.22) ... $10,172.00 ... Over $206,700 but not over $394,600 x 24% (0.24) ... $14,306.00

passages.q: At what rates are qualified dividends taxed on a 2025 joint return?
passages.a: Enter: $48,350 if single or married filing separately, $96,700 if married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse ... Enter: $533,400 if single, $300,000 if married filing separately, $600,050 if married filing jointly ... Multiply line 17 by 15% (0.15).
You had over $1,500 of taxable interest or ordinary dividends.

sources.title: Instructions for Schedule A (Form 1040) (2025), Itemized Deductions

passages.q: How much state and local tax can a joint return deduct for 2025?
passages.a: The overall limit on the deduction for state and local income, sales, and property taxes has increased to $40,000 ($20,000 if married filing separately). The overall limit is reduced if your modified adjusted gross income is more than $500,000 ... but will not be reduced below $10,000 ... Multiply line 6 by 30% (0.30).

passages.q: Can Washington residents deduct general sales tax, and how?
passages.a: If you elect to deduct state and local general sales taxes instead of income taxes, you must check the box on line 5a. To figure your state and local general sales tax deduction, you can use either your actual expenses or the optional sales tax tables.

passages.q: Is all of the mortgage interest deductible?
passages.a: For qualifying debt taken out after December 15, 2017, you can only deduct residence mortgage interest on up to $750,000 ($375,000 if you are married filing separately) of that debt.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 2210 (2025), Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Individuals

passages.a: If your adjusted gross income (AGI) for 2024 was more than $150,000 ($75,000 if your 2025 filing status is married filing separately), substitute 110% for 100% in (2) above.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 6251 (2025), Alternative Minimum Tax

passages.q: Is any alternative minimum tax due?
passages.a: The exemption amount on Form 6251, line 5, has increased to $88,100 ($137,000 if married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse ...). For 2025 ... the 26% tax rate applies to the first $239,100.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 8959 (2025), Additional Medicare Tax

passages.q: Do the Whitfords owe Additional Medicare Tax?
passages.a: A 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax applies to your Medicare wages ... above a threshold amount ... Married filing jointly $250,000 ... Your employer is responsible for withholding the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on your Medicare wages ... paid in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 8960 (2025), Net Investment Income Tax

passages.q: Do the Whitfords owe the net investment income tax?
passages.a: Individuals who have for the tax year (a) MAGI that's over an applicable threshold amount, and (b) NII, must pay 3.8% of the smaller of (a) or (b) as their NIIT ... Married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse is $250,000.

passages.q: Are the cash gifts within the AGI limit?
passages.a: Your deduction for the cash contributions is 60% of your AGI.

passages.q: Does the June refinance stay residence acquisition debt?
passages.a: Any secured debt you use to refinance residence acquisition debt is treated as residence acquisition debt. However, the new debt will qualify as residence acquisition debt only up to the amount of the balance of the old mortgage principal just before the refinancing.

checks.title: Underpayment penalty test (Form 2210): each installment against the required payment
checks.detail: Required annual payment: the smaller of 90% of the 2025 tax ($124,441.21) and 110% of the 2024 tax ($130,460.00): $124,441.21. Withholding counts as paid evenly, $26,685.94 a quarter; with the estimates credited to 2025, every installment is covered. No penalty and no Form 2210, with or without the January payment.
